production.note: US model years. First: Hyundai's pricing release says "All 2019 Veloster N models feature a manual transmission and will begin arriving at dealerships in December" (2018). Last: Hyundai published 2022 Veloster N specifications (hyundai-us-2022-veloster-n-specs); Motor Authority (Joel Feder, 30 June 2022) reports "Hyundai confirmed to Motor Authority the production of Veloster N ends in July" and that it "will not return for the 2023 model year" (motorauthority-veloster-n-discontinued).

body.note: Described as a 'hot hatchback'. Hyundai's spec sheets do not name the body type.

transmission.note: '6-speed manual with Hillstart Assist Control' and '8-speed Wet Dual Clutch Transmission with paddle shifters, (N DCT)'. The DCT was added for 2021; 2019 cars were manual only ('All 2019 Veloster N models feature a manual transmission', hyundai-us-2019-veloster-n-pricing).

powerHp.note: The standard car's rating at launch. Quote (Hyundai 2019 Veloster N specifications): "Horsepower STD: 250 @ 6,000 RPM OPT: 275 @ 6,000 RPM"; Hyundai's pricing release names the two cars as 'the standard manual transmission model' and 'the Performance Package model' with 'up to 275 horsepower' (hyundai-us-2019-veloster-n-pricing). From 2021 only the 275 hp car was sold: Carscoops (Michael Karkafiris, July 2020) says the 2021 car 'will be available only with the more powerful 275 HP Performance Package' (carscoops-2021-veloster-n); Hyundai's 2021 and 2022 sheets give "Horsepower (HP): 275 @ 6000 rpm" (hyundai-us-2021-veloster-n-specs, hyundai-us-2022-veloster-n-specs). The 250 hp standard car was therefore the base car for 2019 and, as far as found, 2020: half of the four model years. Under the guide a later rating replaces the launch rating only if it covered more than half the run, so the launch rating is used. No Hyundai document for 2020 was found.

weightLb.note: Standard (250 hp) car, 6-speed manual (the only 2019 transmission), 2019 model. Quote (Hyundai 2019 specifications): "Curb Weight STD: 3,036-3,047 OPT: 3,106-3,117". Hyundai gives a range for the standard car; the lower figure is the car with standard equipment and is used. The 275 hp car weighs 3,106 lb with the manual in 2021 and 2022 ("MT: 3,106 / DCT: 3,247", hyundai-us-2021-veloster-n-specs).

discrepancies.reason: Model year and equipment: in 2019 the standard car was rated 250 hp and the Performance Package car 275 hp; from 2021 only the 275 hp car was sold.
discrepancies.resolution: Used the launch rating of the standard car, 250 hp, because the 275 hp-only years were not more than half the run.

discrepancies.reason: Equipment: 3,036 lb is the 2019 standard car; 3,106 lb is the 275 hp Performance Package car, the only version from 2021.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,036 lb, the standard car at the reference year 2019.
